test_title: PYST 36: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As announced in May 2025, in which of the following states of India, will the first Artificial Intelligence Special Economic Zone be set up?
solution:
p>The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the announcement in **May 2025**, India’s first **Artificial Intelligence Special Economic Zone (AI SEZ)** is set to be established in the state of **Chhattisgarh**.
 
• This specialized zone will be located in **Naya Raipur (Atal Nagar)**, which is recognized as India's first planned **greenfield smart city**.
 
• The primary objective of this **AI SEZ** is to create a dedicated ecosystem for **technological innovation**, **Machine Learning (ML)**, and **Deep Learning** research and development.
 
• The state government aims to attract global **tech giants** and **startups** by providing specialized infrastructure, **tax incentives**, and high-speed digital connectivity within the zone.
 
• The project is expected to generate significant **employment opportunities** for **IT professionals** and **engineers**, positioning **Chhattisgarh** as a central hub for the **fourth industrial revolution** in India.
 
• By establishing this zone, the state intends to diversify its economy from **mining and metallurgy** towards **high-tech services** and **software exports**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Chhattisgarh.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Special Economic Zones (SEZs) in India**:
 
 
• **SEZs** are duty-free enclaves treated as foreign territory for trade operations, duties, and tariffs.
 
• They are governed by the **Special Economic Zones Act, 2005**, which came into effect in **February 2006**.
 
• The main goals are to increase **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)**, boost exports, and create **large-scale employment**.
 
 
 
• **Naya Raipur (Atal Nagar)**:
 
 
• It is the administrative capital of **Chhattisgarh** and is designed as a **Smart City** with modern amenities.
 
• The city already hosts **IIIT-NR (International Institute of Information Technology)**, which will likely collaborate with the **AI SEZ** for research and skill development.
 
 
 
• **Other Tech Hubs mentioned in options**:
 
 
• **Telangana**: Known for its **Hyderabad IT hub** (HITEC City), the state has a strong **AI framework** and launched the **"Year of AI"** initiative in **2020**.
 
• **Gujarat**: Home to **GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City)**, which is India's first operational **International Financial Services Centre (IFSC)**.
 
• **Haryana**: Features **Gurugram**, a major satellite city known as a **financial and technology center**, housing many **Fortune 500** companies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The setting up of an **AI SEZ** aligns with the **National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence** released by **NITI Aayog**, which focuses on **#AIforAll**.
 
• **Key Benefits**: Units within the **SEZ** typically enjoy **100% Income Tax exemption** on export income for the first **5 years** and **50%** for the next **5 years**.
 
• **Digital India Mission**: This move supports the **Government of India's** vision to transform the country into a **trillion-dollar digital economy** by **2026-27**.
 
• **Central India's Growth**: Traditionally known for **agriculture and industry**, the inclusion of an **AI SEZ** represents a major shift in **Central India's** economic profile towards **knowledge-based industries**.
